Name: (AT) (CP) Pastel Junimo Catalogue
Author: CheeseKayke
Description:
[center]~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~♡~

My first ever recolour mod and hopefully one in a series of recolours I plan on doing for the vanilla game furniture~!
This was heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531]Pinkstations Cotton Candy Recolor[/url] who even allowed me to use it for swatches.

To [b]install[/b], simply download the (AT) or (CP) version and unzip it into your mods folder.﻿﻿

I also highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] alongside the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version to make it easier to view and change items such as the Sleeping Junimo as they all have the same colour variations~!﻿﻿
